DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 丘の休憩所をお探しでしょうか。図では、こちらの印がその場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the hilltop rest shelter? This marker on the map shows it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人がそこで会おうと言っています。地図では近いですが、今日は長く歩きたくないので、楽に行ける道か確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の提案する丘の休憩所が地図で近いが、長く歩きたくないため道の負担を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend suggested meeting there. It looks close on the map, but I don't want to walk far today, so I'd like to check whether the route is easy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the hilltop shelter your friend suggested looks close on the map, but ask how demanding the route is because you don't want a long walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の距離だけでなく、この坂の表示も見ましょう。休憩所は丘の上で、ここから上がる区間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's look at this slope symbol as well as the map distance. The shelter is on top of the hill, and there is an uphill section from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近く見えても上り道なのですね。休憩のためにそこまで行くより、入口の近くで少し歩いて待つ場所に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 距離だけでなく上りがあると理解し、入口付近を少し歩いて待つ場所へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is uphill even though it looks close. Rather than go all that way to rest, I'd like to change to somewhere near the entrance where I can walk a little and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show that you understand there is an uphill section, not just distance, and say you want to change to somewhere near the entrance to walk briefly and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口側の木陰広場は、この短い道の先です。図では丘へ上がらない経路ですが、路面や席の空きはその場でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The shaded square on the entrance side is at the end of this short path. The map shows a route that doesn't climb the hill, but check the surface and available seats when you get there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ木陰広場に変えられるか連絡します。こちらから行って戻るときは、丘を通る一周路へ入らず同じ入口へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人へ木陰広場合流を提案し、丘の一周路へ入らず同じ入口へ戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask my friend whether we can change to the shaded square. When I go from here and return, can I get back to the same entrance without joining the circuit over the hill?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, propose meeting your friend at the shaded square and ask whether you can return to the same entrance without taking the hill circuit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この短い道を往復すれば、丘への分かれ道を進まず戻れます。現在地と入口を印で示しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you go out and back on this short path, you can return without taking the branch toward the hill. I'll mark your current location and the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口と木陰広場を友人にも送ります。今、友人がその場所へ来ると返事をくれたので、丘へ探しに行く必要はなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口と広場の位置を友人へ送り、了承の返事が来たので丘へ探しに行かなくてよくなったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll send my friend the entrance and square locations too. My friend has just replied that they'll come there, so I no longer need to go up the hill looking for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will send your friend the entrance and square locations, and their agreement means you no longer need to search for them on the hill.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流先が決まったのですね。広場に着いて席が使えなくても、無理に別の遠い場所へ動かず、連絡し合ってお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You've settled the meeting place. Even if seats aren't available at the square, don't force yourselves to move somewhere else far away; contact each other and decide together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。席の様子を見て友人と相談します。今日は短い道だけを歩き、帰りもこの入口へ戻ると二人で確認しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 席の状況は友人と相談し、短い往復だけを歩いて同じ入口へ戻ると二人で確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll check the seats and discuss it with my friend. We'll both confirm that today we're only using the short out-and-back route and returning to this entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will discuss the seating situation with your friend and both confirm that you will take only the short round trip and return to the same entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 印を付けた図をどうぞ。丘を経由しない短い往復の道はこちらです。ご友人とご無理のない範囲で、お散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the marked map. This is the short out-and-back route that avoids the hill. Enjoy your walk with your friend without overexerting yourselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物を持って乗り場へ向かわれるのですね。移動の途中で、どのような点がお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're heading to the boarding area with your luggage. What difficulty are you having along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行かばんの車輪が壊れて、階段では運びにくいです。図にある荷物用の昇降設備に、私も一緒に乗れると思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かばんの車輪が壊れ階段で運びにくく、図の荷物用昇降設備へ自分も乗れると思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My suitcase wheel is broken, so stairs are difficult. I thought I could ride along in the luggage lift shown on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that your broken suitcase wheel makes stairs difficult and you thought you could ride in the mapped luggage-lifting equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表示は荷物を扱う設備の案内で、乗客の移動経路とは別です。ご利用のバスの乗り場が分かる物をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That symbol is for equipment handling luggage, separate from passenger routes. Do you have something showing the boarding area for your bus?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この予約案内です。乗り場の番号はありますが、荷物用の印を見つけただけで、そこまでの通り方を確認していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約案内の乗り場番号を示し、荷物用印だけを見て乗客の経路は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This reservation guide. It has the boarding-area number, but I had only found the luggage symbol and hadn't checked the passenger route there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show the boarding-area number in your reservation guide and explain that you only saw the luggage symbol and haven't checked the passenger route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗客が利用できる経路を確認します。かばんを手で持つことはできますか。それとも、運ぶ手助けが必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check a route passengers can use. Can you carry the case by hand, or do you need help moving it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 短い距離なら持てますが、長くは難しいです。手助けを頼めるかと、途中で置いて休める所があるかを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 短距離なら持てるが長くは難しく、手助けの可否と途中の休憩場所を相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can carry it a short distance, but not far. I'd like to ask whether help is available and whether there's somewhere along the way to set it down and rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you can carry it briefly but not far, and want advice on help and somewhere to rest along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応できる職員と休憩場所を照会します。手助けや空いている席はまだお約束できません。出発時刻は迫っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask about available staff and rest areas. We can't promise assistance or an empty seat yet. Is your departure time close?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内の出発時刻は確認できますが、この経路で何分かかるかは分かりません。間に合うと思って先に進まず、必要な時間を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出発時刻は分かるが移動時間は不明で、間に合うと決めず必要時間を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can check the departure time in the guide, but don't know how many minutes this route takes. I don't want to assume I'll make it and go ahead; I'd like to ask the time needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you know the departure time but not the travel time, and want to ask how long is needed without assuming you'll make it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 移動に必要な時間を含めて確認しましょう。設備が使えない場合や対応できる職員がいない場合も、別の方法を相談する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the time needed too. If the equipment can't be used or no staff are available, we'll need to discuss another approach.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使える経路と手助けの可否が分かってから動きます。荷物用設備へ自分で入らず、難しい場合は予約している便の扱いも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 経路と補助可否の確認後に動き、荷物用設備へ入らず難しければ予約便の扱いも相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move after learning the usable route and whether help is available. I won't enter the luggage equipment myself, and if it's difficult I'll also ask what to do about my booked service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will move after confirming the route and assistance, not enter luggage equipment, and consult about your booked service if necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、予約案内を拝見して乗り場と移動の案内を照会します。お荷物をお手元に、この窓口で結果をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll look at the reservation guide and inquire about the boarding area and access. Keep your luggage with you and wait here for the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所の手続きで、日付の欄を確かめたいとのことですね。どの書類の日付をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to check a date field in the address procedure. Which document's date were you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋の契約開始日を転居日として書こうとしました。でも、その日は鍵を受け取っただけで、実際に住み始めたのは後です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約開始日は鍵受取だけで居住開始は後なのに、転居日として写そうとしたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to copy my rental contract's start date as the moving date. But that day I only received the keys; I actually began living there later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you nearly copied the contract start date as the moving date even though you only received keys then and began living there later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約の日と生活を移した日の事情を分けて伺います。旧住所からの移動について、受け取った書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll hear separately about the contract date and the date you moved your life there. Do you have documents received for leaving the old address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前の役所でもらった書類はあります。そこにある日付とも違うので、一番早い日を選んで書けばよいのか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧役所の書類にも別日付があり、最も早い日を書けばよいか迷ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a document from my previous municipal office. Its date differs too, so I wondered whether I should choose the earliest date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the previous office's document has another date and you were unsure whether to write the earliest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日付を推測でそろえず、それぞれが何の日かを担当に説明してください。住み始めた時期を思い出せる記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't guess dates to make them match. Explain what each date represents to the staff. Do you have records to help remember when you started living there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物を運んだ日のメモと、その後ここで生活を始めた日の予定表があります。違いを説明して、どの欄に何を書くか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物運搬と生活開始の記録があり、違いを説明して記入欄を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note of the day I moved my belongings and a calendar entry for the later day I began living here. I'd like to explain the difference and check what belongs in each field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you have records of moving belongings and starting residence, and want to explain the difference and check the fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その記録と書類を担当へお持ちください。本人確認や、現在のお住まいについて確認できる物も拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Bring those records and documents to the staff. We'll also look at identification and something confirming your current residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードと契約書を持っています。今日この相談をしただけで、住所変更が全て終わったとは考えず、足りない物も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在留カードと契約書を示し、相談だけで住所変更全て完了と考えず不足も教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card and contract. I won't assume all address changes are finished just because I consulted today, so please tell me anything missing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show your residence card and contract, avoid assuming consultation completes all address changes, and ask about missing items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な手続きと期限は、ご本人の状況に応じて照会します。住所以外に、関連して相談したいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll inquire about the necessary procedures and deadlines according to your circumstances. Is there anything related besides your address that you'd like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保険についても転居に伴う相談先を知りたいです。まず日付の事情を伝え、住所と保険のどの確認が残るかをメモして進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保険の転居相談先も聞き、日付事情を伝えて住所と保険の残る確認をメモして進めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd also like to know whom to consult about insurance after moving. I'll first explain the dates, then note which address and insurance checks remain as I proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask for the insurance contact after moving, and say you will explain the dates and note the remaining address and insurance checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、日付の記録と書類をそろえて担当へご案内します。申請書はまだ日付を決めず、説明を受けてから記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take you to the staff with the date records and documents together. Don't decide the application date yet; fill it in after the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察日の変更をご希望ですね。いまお持ちの予約案内は、診察の一枚だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to change your consultation date. Do you have only one appointment notice, for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察の予約票のほかに、検査の日を書いた紙もあります。仕事で行けないので、診察を変えれば検査も一緒に変わると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察と別紙の検査予約があり、仕事で診察を変えれば両方変わると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Besides the consultation slip, I have a paper with a test date. I can't go because of work and thought changing the consultation would change the test too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that the consultation and test are on separate papers and you thought changing the consultation because of work would change both.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別の予約がある場合は、それぞれ確認が必要です。二枚の日付と、検査の案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Separate appointments each need checking. May I see the two dates and the test instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 検査は診察より前の日でした。診察の時刻だけ見ていたので、検査の日も仕事と重なっていることに今気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査が診察前の日で、検査日も仕事と重なることに気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The test is on a day before the consultation. I was only looking at the consultation time, and have just realized the test date also conflicts with work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say the test precedes the consultation and you have realized its date also conflicts with work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 両方の変更希望として担当へ照会します。症状の変化や、薬がなくなりそうなど、先に伝えることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll ask the staff about your wish to change both. Is there anything to report first, such as changed symptoms or medicine running low?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 症状は今のところ変わりません。薬が次の診察まで足りるかはまだ数えていないので、受診を延ばして大丈夫とは自分で決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 症状変化はないが薬の残量は未確認で、受診延期の可否を自分で決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My symptoms haven't changed so far. I haven't counted whether my medicine lasts until the next consultation, so I won't decide myself that delaying the visit is safe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say symptoms are unchanged but medicine supply is unchecked, and you won't decide yourself whether postponing the visit is acceptable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も担当に伝えます。変更できる範囲は診療側の確認が必要ですので、まず来院可能な候補を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll report that too. The clinical staff must check the scope of changes, so may I first ask which appointment options you can attend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の午後に二つ候補があります。同じ先生を希望しますが、その希望だけで検査を遅らせてよいとは考えず、調整を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来週午後の二候補と同医師希望を伝え、それだけで検査を遅らせず調整を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have two afternoon options next week. I'd prefer the same doctor, but won't assume that preference alone makes delaying the test acceptable; I'd like to discuss coordination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, give two afternoon options next week and a preference for the same doctor, but consult about coordination rather than delaying the test for that reason alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補とご希望を照会します。検査の準備についても担当へ尋ねますので、変更が決まった場合には、どの案内に従うか改めて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll ask about those options and preferences. We'll also ask about test preparation; if a change is settled, check again which instructions to follow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今ある検査案内を捨てずに残します。診察と検査の新しい日時、準備の説明、元の予約の扱いをそれぞれ確認してから予定を書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧検査案内を残し、診察検査の新日時・準備・元予約の扱いを別々に確認して予定を直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the current test instructions rather than discard them. I'll update my schedule after separately confirming the new consultation and test dates and times, preparation, and what happens to the original appointments.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, retain the old test instructions and say you will revise your schedule after separately checking new consultation/test times, preparation, and original appointments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二枚を拝見して担当へつなぎます。まだ予約変更は完了していませんので、確認結果をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll look at both papers and connect you with the staff. The appointment changes aren't complete yet, so please wait for the findings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見当たらない自転車は、ご自身の物でしょうか。それとも、お借りになっている物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the missing bicycle your own, or one you're borrowing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行中に借りた自転車です。店の近くに停めて戻るとなく、まず携帯の写真を見せればよいと思って相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行中に借りた自転車を店近くに停めて戻るとなく、まず写真を見せればよいと思って相談に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a bicycle I rented while traveling. I parked near a shop and it was gone when I returned. I came for advice thinking I should first show the photo on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that a bicycle rented while traveling was missing after you returned to where you parked near a shop, and you came thinking a photo would be the first thing to show.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借りた自転車だと分かる記録や、貸出元の連絡先はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a record showing it's rented, or the rental provider's contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 利用の控えが携帯にあります。車体の番号も載っていますが、写真があれば十分だと思い、貸出元にはまだ連絡していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯に利用控えと車体番号があるが写真で十分と思い貸出元へ未連絡と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The rental receipt is on my phone. It has the bicycle number too, but I thought the photo was enough and haven't contacted the provider yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say your phone has the rental receipt and bicycle number, but you thought the photo was sufficient and haven't contacted the rental provider.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えの番号と車体写真は分けて確認します。最後に停めた所は、指定された駐輪場所かどうか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the receipt number separately from the bicycle photo. Do you remember whether the last parking spot was a designated bicycle area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店の脇の列に停めましたが、指定場所だったかは確かめていません。移されたのか盗まれたのかは分からず、鍵は手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店脇の列が指定駐輪場か未確認で、移動か盗難か不明だが鍵は手元と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I parked in a row beside the shop but didn't check whether it was designated. I don't know whether it was moved or stolen; I still have the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that designation of the row beside the shop is unchecked, movement versus theft is unknown, and you have the key.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 停めた位置や、周囲の案内も手掛かりになります。貸出元にも、車体の確認や連絡先について相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The parked position and nearby signs can provide clues. Ask the rental provider about identifying the bicycle and whom to contact too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 貸出元へ連絡し、控えの番号と停めた場所を伝えます。警察へ相談しただけで、借りている料金が止まるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貸出元へ番号と場所を伝え、警察相談だけで利用料金停止とは考えないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll contact the provider with the receipt number and parking location. I'll be careful not to assume that consulting the police alone stops the rental charges.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will give the provider the number and location, without assuming police consultation alone stops rental fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用料金や契約の扱いは貸出元にご確認ください。こちらでは、見当たらなくなった状況を順に伺います。場所を地図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check rental fees and contract handling with the provider. Here we'll ask in order about the disappearance. Can you show the location on a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この店の脇です。目印と戻った時刻を説明し、貸出元から分かったことも追加で伝えます。写真だけで私の所有物だと届けるのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図で店脇を示し目印と戻った時刻を説明し、貸出元の情報も追加して私物と申告しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Beside this shop. I'll explain the landmark and return time, and add anything learned from the provider. I won't report it as my property based only on the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, point beside the shop on the map, explain the landmark and return time, add provider information, and avoid declaring it your own property.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、借用中の自転車として控えと地図を拝見します。所有や移動の状況はまだ確認中ですので、分かる事実からご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll look at the receipt and map as a rented bicycle. Ownership and any movement are still being checked, so explain the facts you know first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類を送った後の記録を残したいとのことですね。提出先から、どのような記録を求められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want records after sending documents. What records does the recipient require?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請書の案内に、配達を確認できる方法で送るようにあります。追跡が付けば、申請が受け付けられた証明にもなると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配達確認できる方法との指示があり、追跡付きなら申請受付の証明にもなると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The application instructions say to use a method that confirms delivery. I thought tracking would also prove the application was received for processing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that delivery confirmation is required and you thought tracking also proved application acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達状況が分かることと、提出先が内容を確認して受け付けることは別です。案内に、申請の受付確認についても説明がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Knowing delivery status and the recipient checking and accepting the contents are separate. Do the instructions explain application-acceptance confirmation too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別の欄に、受付後に連絡すると書かれています。郵便の配達完了が出ても、その連絡まで終わったという意味ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別欄の受付後連絡を見つけ、郵便の配達完了とその通知は別と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Another section says they'll contact me after acceptance. So even if postal delivery shows complete, it doesn't mean that notification is complete too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, find the separate post-acceptance notification section and confirm that completed postal delivery is different from that notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。発送方法は配達に関する条件に合わせて選びましょう。受取の記録などについて、さらに指定が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Choose a shipping method according to delivery conditions. Are there further requirements, such as a record of receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 記録を残すとだけあり、誰が受け取ったかの記録まで必要か分かりません。自己判断で一番安い方法にせず、提出先へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 誰の受取記録まで必要か不明なので、最安を自己判断で選ばず提出先へ確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It only says to keep records. I don't know whether a record of who received it is needed. I want to check with the recipient rather than choose the cheapest method myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say the need for a named recipient record is unclear, so you want to ask the recipient rather than choose the cheapest option yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な条件が分かれば、料金と利用できる方法を比較できます。封筒の宛先は、個人名ですか、それとも担当部署でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once the conditions are known, we can compare prices and available methods. Is the envelope addressed to a person or a department?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当部署宛てです。この部署名も含めて住所を確認し、申請書の控えを残してから封をします。内容がそろうかは自分でも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 部署宛てと答え、部署名と住所を確認し申請控えを残して封をし内容も自分で点検すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: A department. I'll check the address including that department's name, keep a copy of the application, and then seal it. I'll also check myself that all contents are present.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, answer that it is department-addressed, and say you will check department/address, keep an application copy before sealing, and check the contents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒の表記は確認をお手伝いできますが、申請内容の審査はできません。発送後の控えと、先方からの連絡は別々に保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can help check the envelope wording, but can't assess the application contents. Store your shipping receipt separately from the recipient's notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件を確認してから送り方を決め、郵便の控えを残します。配達後も申請の受付連絡がなければ、郵便の表示だけで済ませず提出先に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後に方法を決め郵便控えを残し、配達後に受付連絡がなければ先方へ別途尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide the shipping method after checking the conditions and retain the postal receipt. If there's no acceptance notification after delivery, I'll ask the recipient separately rather than rely only on the postal display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, decide the method after checking conditions, retain the postal receipt, and separately ask the recipient if no acceptance notice arrives after delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、今日は指定事項の確認までにしましょう。先方の回答と封筒をお持ちになれば、その条件に合う方法を改めてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's stop today at checking the specified requirements. Bring the recipient's reply and envelope, and we'll explain methods matching those conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与の受取口座についてのご相談ですね。現在お持ちの口座はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about a salary account. Do you already have an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の仕事で使っていた口座があります。でも、新しい会社から口座の情報を出すように言われたので、こちらで作り直す必要があると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前職の口座はあるが新会社から情報提出を求められ、作り直す必要があると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the one I used at my previous job. But the new company asked for account information, so I thought I needed to open another one here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you have a previous-job account but assumed a new one was necessary after the new company requested information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社が指定している条件は、案内に書かれていますか。新しい口座が必須かどうかは、勤務先にも確認していただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the company's conditions in the instructions? You'll also need to ask your employer whether a new account is mandatory.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には銀行名や番号を書く欄だけで、新規開設とは書かれていません。以前の口座を使えるかは、まだ会社へ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社案内は銀行名番号欄だけで新規指定はなく、旧口座の利用可否も未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The guide only has fields for bank name and number; it doesn't say to open a new one. I haven't asked whether the existing account can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say the company's guide has only bank-name/number fields, no new-account requirement, and use of the old account is unchecked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず勤務先の条件を確かめましょう。もし開設を申し込む場合は、目的やご本人の状況に応じた確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First check your employer's conditions. If you apply, we'll need checks according to your purpose and circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ用途の口座を急いで増やす前に、会社へ聞きます。開設が必要となった場合に備え、持ってきた書類で何を確認するかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同用途口座を増やす前に会社へ聞き、必要時に備え持参書類の確認内容を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask the company before rushing to add another account for the same purpose. In case one is needed, I'd also like to know what you'll check in the documents I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you will ask the company before adding another same-purpose account, and want to know the document checks in case opening one is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの物を伺って、担当へ照会します。必要な書類があっても、その場で開設できるとお約束するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask what you have and inquire with the staff. Even having the necessary documents is not a promise of opening an account immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードと勤務先の案内があります。会社の提出期限は近いですが、今日口座番号が出ると決めず、間に合わない場合の相談も会社にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在留カードと会社案内を示し、期限が近いが即日番号発行と決めず遅れる場合は会社へ相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card and company instructions. The submission deadline is close, but I won't assume an account number will be issued today; I'll discuss with the company what if I can't meet it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, show your residence card and instructions, and say that despite the close deadline you won't assume a same-day number and will ask the company about delays.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類の確認と申込方法をご案内します。なお、勤務先への提出期限と、銀行で確認が終わる時期は別にお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain document checks and application methods. Please distinguish your employer's submission deadline from when the bank finishes its checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず会社へ既存口座が使えるかと、期限に間に合わない場合の扱いを聞きます。必要なら不足書類と申込手順を確認し、分からない項目は署名前に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存口座可否と期限対応を会社へ聞き、必要なら不足書類と手順を確認し署名前に不明点を尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll ask whether I can use my existing account and what happens if I miss the deadline. If needed, I'll check missing documents and application steps, and ask about unclear fields before signing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, ask the company about the existing account and deadline handling, then if necessary check missing documents and steps, asking unclear points before signing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、本日は開設が必要な場合の相談として書類を拝見します。新規開設の申込みと決めず、会社の条件確認と並行してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today we'll look at your documents as advice in case opening is needed. We won't treat this as a definite new-account application, and will guide you alongside checking the company's conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 収納袋の割引表示について、どの組み合わせが対象かお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking which combinations qualify for the storage-bag discount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大きい袋と小さい袋を一つずつ選びました。二点目割引とあるので、この二つでも安くなると思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大小の収納袋を一つずつ選び、二点目割引がその二つに適用と思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I selected one large and one small bag. It says discount on the second item, so I thought these two would cost less too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you selected one large and one small storage bag and thought the second-item discount applied to them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象の商品名や容量、組み合わせの条件を確認しましょう。値札の小さい文字はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check product names, capacities and combination conditions. Have you read the small print on the price tag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ種類の二点という言葉があります。見た目が似ているので同じだと思いましたが、二つの容量と商品名は違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同種類二点の文言を見つけ、見た目は似るが容量と商品名が違うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says two of the same type. They look similar, so I thought they were the same, but the capacities and product names differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, find the same-type condition and say that despite similar appearance the capacities and product names differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た目だけで対象とは決められません。商品と表示を照合しますが、もともと必要な量はどのくらいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Appearance alone doesn't establish eligibility. We'll compare the products and signs, but how much did you originally need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本当に必要なのは小さいほう一つだけです。割引になると思って大きいほうも取りましたが、一つ買う場合の価格を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要なのは小さい一つだけで割引目的に大きい物も取ったと説明し、一点価格を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I really need only one small bag. I picked up the large one because I thought there was a discount, but want to know the single-item price first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that only one small bag is needed and the large one was chosen for a discount, then ask the single-item price first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一点の価格と、条件に合う組み合わせの合計を確認します。会員など、追加の条件が書かれていないかも見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the price of one and the total for qualifying combinations. Let's also look for additional conditions, such as membership.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会員登録はしていません。登録するつもりもないので、会員向けの表示なら適用されない場合の価格で比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 非会員で登録予定もなく、会員条件なら割引なしの価格で比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm not a member and don't plan to register. If the price is for members, I want to compare the prices without that discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you are not a member, don't plan to join, and want to compare nondiscounted prices if membership is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望に合う条件で確認します。割引を使うために、必要のない商品まで選ぶ必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check under conditions matching your wishes. You don't need to select unnecessary items just to use a discount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さいほう一つの確定した価格を聞いてから選びます。大きい袋は買うと決めず、会計前に対象商品と合計が合っているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小さい一点の価格確認後に選び、大袋は保留して会計前に対象品と合計を照合したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose after hearing the confirmed price for one small bag. I won't decide to buy the large one yet, and want to check the eligible item and total before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, choose after confirming one small item's price, leave the large bag undecided, and ask to compare eligible products and total before payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、小さい袋の商品名を値札と照合します。まだ会計へ進まず、適用条件と一点の価格の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll compare the small bag's product name with the price tag. Don't proceed to checkout yet; wait for the discount conditions and single-item price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池の近くへ行く道を、図で確かめたいのですね。どの線を通るおつもりでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to check the path near the pond on the map. Which line were you planning to follow?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この点線に沿って歩けば、池を見て短く戻れると思いました。長い散歩はしたくないので、近道かどうか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 点線を使い池を見て短く戻れると思い、長く歩かない近道か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought following this dotted line would let me see the pond and return quickly. I don't want a long walk, so please tell me whether it's a shortcut.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you thought the dotted line offered a short return after seeing the pond, and ask whether it's a shortcut to avoid a long walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この凡例では、点線は区域の境界を示しています。歩ける道を示す線とは別なので、点線だけを頼りに進むことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this legend, the dotted line marks an area boundary. It differs from a walkable-path line, so you can't proceed relying on the dots alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 道の印だと思っていました。境界なら、そのまま池まで歩けると決めず、実際の園路がどれかを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 点線を道と思ったが境界と分かり、池へ歩けると決めず実際の園路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it marked a path. If it's a boundary, I won't assume I can walk straight to the pond; I'd like to know the actual park path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you mistook the dots for a path but now know it's a boundary, and ask the actual path without assuming pond access.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 園路の表示を見て確認しましょう。池の周りを一周することと、少し眺めることでは、どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the path symbols. Do you want to walk all around the pond or just see it briefly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一周はしなくてよく、少し見られれば十分です。遠回りになるなら、入口に近い道だけにして戻るつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一周せず少し見れば十分で、遠回りなら入口近くの道だけで戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't need a full circuit; a brief look is enough. If it means a detour, I'll only use paths near the entrance and return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say a brief look without a circuit is sufficient, and if it would be a detour you'll stay near the entrance and return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口に戻る道も合わせて照合しましょう。休憩場所の表示はこちらですが、そこまでの道の状態や空席は、今ここでは確定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's compare the route back to the entrance too. Here's the rest-area symbol, but we can't confirm the path condition there or seat availability from here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空席や近道があると期待して奥へ行かず、案内された道の範囲で考えます。戻る途中の分かれ道で、どの表示を見ればよいかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空席や近道を期待して奥へ行かず案内道で考え、帰路の分岐で見る表示も確かめたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't go farther inside expecting a free seat or shortcut; I'll plan within the routes you've indicated. I'd also like to check which signs to follow at the return-path junction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, avoid going inward expecting seats or shortcuts, plan within the indicated path, and ask which signs to check at the return junction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在地と入口の表示を図で指してみてください。分かれ道で分からなくなった場合は、印のない方向へ進まず、近くの案内を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please point to the current location and entrance on the map. If unsure at a junction, don't proceed in an unmarked direction; check nearby guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここが現在地で、戻る入口はこちらですね。点線を園路として使わず、道と帰りの表示を確認して、短い範囲だけ歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在地と戻る入口を図で示し、点線を園路に使わず道と帰り表示を確認して短く歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's the current location, and this is the entrance to return to. I won't use the dotted line as a park path; I'll check the paths and return signs and walk only a short distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, point to the current location and return entrance, say you won't follow dots as a path, and will check path/return signs for a short walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その入口の位置をもう一度照合しましょう。道の案内を確認できてから出発し、予定にこだわらずお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46222-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, let's compare that entrance position again. Start only after confirming path guidance, and return without being bound to the plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路検索の画面ですね。どちらからどちらへ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a route-search screen. Where are you traveling from and to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここから友人の最寄り駅へ行きたいです。でも、この画面は出発地が友人の駅で、目的地が今いる駅になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ここから友人最寄り駅へ行くのに画面の出発地と目的地が逆だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go from here to my friend's nearest station. But the screen starts at my friend's station and ends at the station I'm at now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you want to go from here to your friend's nearest station, but the screen's origin and destination are reversed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは逆向きの検索結果ですね。友人の方は、帰りの例として送ったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those are results for the reverse direction. Did your friend send them as an example of the return trip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうかもしれません。友人から「帰りはこの経路」と届いていたのに、行きも同じ画面でよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の帰りの経路というメッセージを行きにも使えると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Maybe. My friend said ‘this is the route back,’ but I thought the same screen would work for going there too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: In Japanese, explain that you thought your friend's return-route message could also be used for the outward trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行きは出発地と目的地を入れ直して確認しましょう。今日は、出発できる時刻から調べますか。それとも到着の希望がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For going there, let's enter the origin and destination again. Shall we search from when you can depart today, or do you have a desired arrival?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今から出られます。待合せの時刻はまだ決めていないので、行きの所要時間を調べてから友人に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今から出発でき、待合せ未定なので所要時間を調べてから友人に伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can leave now. We haven't set a meeting time, so I'd like to check the outward travel time and then tell my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you can leave now, the meeting time is unset, and you want to tell your friend after checking the journey time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、現在地を出発、友人の最寄り駅を到着として調べます。帰りも今日のご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll search from your current station to your friend's nearest one. Are you also returning today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは明日です。今日の行きと明日の帰りを、一つの検索結果で判断しないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰りは明日で、今日の行きと同じ検索結果にまとめて判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll return tomorrow. I don't want to judge today's outward and tomorrow's return journeys from a single result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: In Japanese, say you return tomorrow and won't combine it with today's outward trip in one search result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれ日付と向きを分けて確認しましょう。帰りの時刻が未定なら、切符の条件もその点を含めて相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check each date and direction separately. If your return time is unset, we can also discuss ticket conditions with that in mind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず行きの画面の出発地と目的地を確認します。帰りの切符は先に決めず、明日の予定がわかってから条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行きの両端を先に確認し、帰りの切符条件は明日の予定判明後に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I'll check the origin and destination on the outward screen. I won't settle the return ticket yet; I'll ask the conditions once I know tomorrow's plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: In Japanese, check both ends of the outward journey first and say you will discuss return-ticket conditions after tomorrow's plans are known.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、行きの検索から一緒に確認しましょう。友人から届いた帰りの例は、別の情報として残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-46223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the outward search together first. Keep your friend's return example as separate information.
